pages.description: Watch electricity dance with this interactive plasma ball for ages 14+. A fascinating STEM gift from Cogs Toys & Games Ireland. Touch the glass to see!
pages.ld_description:
Plasma Ball – Thames & Kosmos


Recommended for ages 14 years and up, providing a safe and fascinating way to explore electricity and plasma.


Features a glass globe filled with plasma filaments that respond to touch, creating dancing streams of colorful light.


Interactive design reacts to both physical contact and sound, producing stunning light shows to music. ⚡


Demonstrates important physics concepts such as electric fields, ionized gases, and energy transfer.


Compact and durable design makes it perfect for use as a desk accessory, bedroom décor, or science project centerpiece.


Safe for educational use with low current, offering captivating effects without danger.


What’s in the box: Plasma ball globe, base stand with power switch, power adapter, and instruction manual. 🌟


Bring science to life with this mesmerizing plasma ball! Whether for learning, decoration, or fun, it inspires curiosity and wonder, turning electricity into an unforgettable light show. ✨
